caption: The drawing features a rectangular ornamental grille rendered in gray pencil or ink, centered on a beige or light brown background. The grille consists of two horizontal rows, each containing a symmetrical design with two stylized fish-like creatures facing each other nose-to-nose, forming a mirrored pattern. Each fish has a rounded head, an open mouth, and a body that broadens to ornate, leaf-like fins. The creatures are framed by looping, scrollwork lines forming ovals around them, with additional small spiral motifs in each corner of the rectangle. The grille is bordered by a simple, double-line rectangular frame. Fine, linear hatchings and stippling create the texture and shading of the ornamental details. Subtle guide marks and a faint signature or notation are visible near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Window Grille
